presentation.title: 👋 Hi, I'm Florent
presentation.subtitle: Backend .NET Developer — future Provençal seeking a permanent position
presentation.seekingJobBanner: 🟢 Available for a permanent position from September 2026 — Marseille · Aix-en-Provence · Toulon
presentation.locationBadge: 📍 Currently in Amiens — Moving to Provence in September 2026
presentation.firstParagraph: Originally from Nogent-le-Rotrou, in the heart of the Perche region of Normandy, I grew up surrounded by nature and a growing curiosity for technology. It all started at 14 when I discovered Python programming — an instant passion. My computer science elective in high school deepened it, and my studies in Amiens — a Bachelor's in Computer Science at the IUT, then a Master's in Cloud Computing & Mobility at INSSET in Saint-Quentin — gave me solid technical foundations I keep refining every day as an apprentice at Orange Business.
presentation.secondParagraph: I'm a Backend Developer specialized in .NET & C#. My playground: clean RESTful APIs, solid clean architecture, SQL Server, and well-thought-out dependency injection. I also do front-end work with Vue.js — which gives me a useful dual perspective for documenting my APIs precisely. But backend is where I truly thrive.
presentation.philosophyText: Before writing a single line of code, I make sure I fully understand the business need and the end goal. I start by designing the database architecture and API contracts, then build brick by brick, keeping code clean, testable, and maintainable. When a bug hits, no band-aids — I trace it to the root, fix the flaw, and write a test to make sure it never comes back.

values.knowledgeSharing: Knowledge sharing & constructive code reviews — growing together
values.documentation: Careful documentation (Swagger, README) to make life easier for the whole team
values.pragmatism: Rigour & pragmatism: understand before coding, fix issues at the source
values.continuousImprovement: Continuous improvement — technically and personally, never settling for the status quo

presentation.goalText: At the end of my studies, in September 2026, I'm moving to Provence — my family is there, and that's where I want to build the next chapter of my career. I'm looking for a permanent position in software development in Marseille, Aix-en-Provence or Toulon, ideally backend-focused, within a team where code quality and good atmosphere matter as much as technical skills.
presentation.goalCTA: Permanent role in Marseille · Aix-en-Provence · Toulon — from Sept. 2026

first.title: Developer — Internship
first.shortDesc: First professional experience with .NET at Orange Business.
first.content: End-of-year internship during my 2nd year of BUT in Computer Science. Integrated into a team of consultants, I discovered the .NET Core world in real conditions: developed a REST API in C# following clean architecture principles as part of an internal project.
first.tech: .NET Core · C# · ASP.NET · Clean Architecture · Git

second.title: Developer — Extended Internship
second.shortDesc: Direct follow-up to the spring internship — increased responsibilities.
second.content: Contract signed right after the first internship. I continued and extended the initial project by developing a new clean architecture API and an internal web back office. Skill development in unit testing and technical documentation.
second.tech: .NET Core · C# · ASP.NET · xUnit · Swagger · Git · Azure DevOps

third.title: Consultant — Apprenticeship
third.shortDesc: Apprenticeship as part of Year 3 BUT and Master CCM — full-stack .NET & JS consultant.
third.content: Consultant on Microsoft and JavaScript technologies within an Agile team. Development and maintenance of REST APIs in ASP.NET Core (clean architecture, CQRS), front-end development with Vue.js 3 and Angular on internal business applications. CI/CD via Azure DevOps, active participation in Scrum ceremonies and code reviews.
third.tech: ASP.NET Core · C# · Vue.js 3 · Angular · TypeScript · SQL Server · Azure DevOps · Docker

first.title: Bachelor in Computer Science (BUT)

first.content3: Elected student representative on the IUT Amiens Council: attended meetings, represented student interests, and contributed to the institution's academic direction.
